name: HI-TOM
description: Theory of Mind (ToM) is the ability to reason about one's own and others' mental states. ToM plays a critical role in the development of intelligence, language understanding, and cognitive processes. While previous work has primarily focused on first and second-order ToM, we explore higher-order ToM, which involves recursive reasoning on others' beliefs. We introduce HI-TOM, a Higher Order Theory of Mind benchmark. Our experimental evaluation using various Large Language Models (LLMs) indicates a decline in performance on higher-order ToM tasks, demonstrating the limitations of current LLMs. We conduct a thorough analysis of different failure cases of LLMs, and share our thoughts on the implications of our findings on the future of NLP.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark for higher-order theory-of-mind evaluation in LLMs, cited in social cognition and NLP reasoning discussions.
notes: Small, specialized text benchmark; higher-order ToM is challenging for current LLMs and results can be sensitive to prompt format.
